liv.prompt: Full-length character concept illustration of Liv Harkon, a fourteen-year-old girl scout in a historical winter fantasy. Refined detailed anime character art, beautiful delicate precise linework, soft painterly cel shading, natural facial features and anatomy, carefully rendered eyes and hair. Youthful round cheeks, small adolescent build and shoulders, reserved alert expression. An assassin-style charcoal hood frames her face; chestnut hair peeks out. Fully buttoned high-collar ivory tunic, layered charcoal cloak with burgundy lining, loose dark trousers, gloves, practical flat ankle boots, utility belt and small pouches. Modest warm everyday adventure clothing. Neutral upright standing pose, hands relaxed, entire figure head to boots visible. Plain warm off-white background, subtle ground shadow. Detailed elegant textile tailoring and subtle silver clasps. Character art for a literary encyclopedia, polished consistent anime visual-novel rendering.

map.prompt: Create a subtle antique cartographer's blank paper texture overlay for a historical fantasy atlas. Entire landscape canvas is pale ivory parchment, softly mottled warm watercolor fibers, extremely subtle tea stains at edges, elegant fine copperplate wind roses and botanical flourishes only within outermost corners, very faint ruled neatlines near edges. Central 85 percent almost uniform pale cream and clear. Flat evenly illuminated top-down scan. No map, no landmasses, no text, no characters, no objects, no deep creases. Designed as a translucent decorative layer over a real geographic map, restrained museum manuscript aesthetics.
